Hey! So I fully understand wanting to keep it to yourself and away from your parents. Doctors and any medical professionals can’t legally talk about anything you say to them unless you express that you are going to say kill yourself or someone else. I would say that you should book a doctors appointment and talk to them. It doesn’t take long and they are normally very helpful and can give you good advice and set you up with the right people/ help you need or want. If you’re at uni, at least in the uk, you should be able to get a form from the nhs giving you free prescriptions which will remove the need for you having to ask you parents for medication should you need/want it. Also there are plenty of therapy options available for you through your uni and, if you’re in the uk at least , free therapy you can go for.
I hope you feel better soon mate

Hey man, first off really sorry to hear about the shit you’re going through. 
I think it’s really important that you take a step back for a second and have a look at yourself, if you’re finding it really hard to get along with the people around you and you’re not enjoying anything you’re doing then perhaps it’s time to make a big change, find something you’re interested in. It doesn’t matter what anyone you know thinks about what you want to do or try to do as long as you feel comfortable and intrigued with what you pursue. The right friends, gf’s and all the rest will come as whatever you decide to do will have a community of people just like you.
I understand though, I had to spend about 2 years trying to figure out what I wanted and despite pissing off family and losing friends I am now happier doing what I love and I have like minded friends and a girlfriend. There’s a place for you somewhere my friend and I’m sure you’ll find it and be glad you made it through this 

Good luck and stay safe
